N01#1.zh: 娘，过了这个山头就快到延安府了；高俅的追兵应该就不会继续追来。娘，再振作一点！
N01#1.t: Mother, once we're over this ridge we're nearly at Yan'an. Gao Qiu's men shouldn't chase us that far. Hold on a little longer, Mother!

N01#2.zh: 儿啊, 我已经跑不动了,不要管我这个老人了, 赶紧自己逃命吧！
N01#2.t: My son, I can't run any more. Leave this old woman behind and save yourself!

N01#3.zh: 王教头，辛苦你啦！新任的高太尉请你前去叙叙，你何必乘夜逃走呢？堂堂八十万禁军教头竟做这偷偷摸摸的事,岂不丢脸？
N01#3.t: Instructor Wang, you've had a long night! The new Marshal Gao only wished to have a word with you. Why sneak off in the dark? An instructor of eight hundred thousand Imperial Guards, creeping away like a thief. Have you no shame?

N01#4.zh: 宴无好宴,会无好会；我王进怎会不知这是场鸿门宴？高俅逮到这个机会，岂不借机报仇？！
N01#4.t: No feast comes without a price. Do you think I can't see a trap when it's laid for me? Gao Qiu has his chance at last. Of course he means to take his revenge!

N01#5.zh: 太尉有令！如果请不回王教头，则以『怠忽职守，弃职逃亡』的罪名逮捕！张三，李四，你们从左边包围；周五，王六，你们从右边包围。不能让犯人逃走！
N01#5.t: By order of the Marshal! If Instructor Wang will not come, he is to be arrested for deserting his post! Zhang San, Li Si, close in from the left. Zhou Wu, Wang Liu, from the right. Don't let him get away!

N01#6.t: Mother! Go! I'll hold them off!

N01#8.zh: 胜利条件   --- 让王母逃到撤退区域
N01#8.t: Victory --- Get Wang's mother to the retreat zone

N01#9.zh: 失败条件一 --- 王进被杀害

N01#10.zh: 失败条件二 --- 王母被杀害

N01#11.zh: 这么多人打一个人，你们还有一丝的羞耻心吗？
N01#11.t: So many men against one. Haven't you got a shred of shame?

N01#12.zh: 你是谁！竟敢阻碍官军办案！
N01#12.t: Who are you? How dare you obstruct the Emperor's soldiers!

N01#13.zh: 以官压民，以多胜少；官呀，官呀，全是一群狐假虎威的家伙...
N01#13.t: Bullying the people with rank, winning with numbers. Officials, officials... nothing but foxes borrowing the tiger's roar...

N01#14.zh: 这位壮士，请不要插手！他们要的是我王进一个人，他们不会为难你的。
N01#14.t: Please, stranger, stay out of this! It's only me they want. They won't trouble you.

N01#15.zh: 你...你还不报上姓名！再向前就以『帮助逃亡』的罪名把你捉起来！
N01#15.t: You... Give your name! One more step and we'll arrest you for aiding a fugitive!

N01#16.zh: 我乃%N。众位大哥何不就此罢手，回报王进已经不知去向；否则拳脚无情，拆筋断骨可是很痛的...
N01#16.t: I am %N. Why don't you gentlemen call it a day and report that Wang Jin has vanished? Otherwise my fists won't be gentle, and broken bones hurt, you know...

N01#17.zh: 原来你跟犯人是一伙的！来人啊！顺便把这个共犯一起抓回去讨赏！
N01#17.t: So you're in league with the fugitive! Men! Seize this accomplice too, there'll be a reward for him!

N01#19.zh: 胜利条件   --- 让王母逃到撤退区域
N01#19.t: Victory --- Get Wang's mother to the retreat zone

N01#20.zh: 失败条件一 --- 王进被杀害

N01#21.zh: 失败条件二 --- 王母被杀害

N01#23.zh: 限制回合数已到，未完成任务，游戏失败！
N01#23.t: The turn limit has run out with the mission unfinished. Game over!

N01#24.zh: 王母在混战之中被官兵所杀，悲愤的王进冲入敌阵，击毙数名官兵，后被乱刀砍死；%N奋力杀出敌阵，隔日遭官府全面通缉，从此亡命天涯........
N01#24.t: Wang's mother was killed in the melee. Mad with grief, Wang Jin charged the soldiers, struck down several, and was hacked to death. %N fought his way out, but was named an outlaw the very next day, and spent the rest of his life on the run........

N01#25.zh: 王进为救母亲，被官兵所包围，%N援救不及，王进被杀，王母也随之自尽，%N虽逃出生天，却每每自责其罪，三年后，抑郁而终，享年二十八岁..........
N01#25.t: Wang Jin was surrounded while trying to save his mother, and %N could not reach him in time. Wang Jin was killed, and his mother took her own life. %N escaped, but never forgave himself. Three years later he died of grief, aged twenty-eight..........

N01#26.zh: %N为官兵所擒杀，王进孤掌难鸣，终失手被擒，被解押回京，后在狱中为高俅所害........
N01#26.t: %N was captured and killed by the soldiers. Alone, Wang Jin could not hold out. He was taken, sent back to the capital in chains, and later murdered in prison by Gao Qiu........

N01#27.zh: 唉...这该怎么才好；为了我的事，又把一个人淌入这场混水中...
N01#27.t: Ah... what am I to do? Because of my troubles, another man has been dragged into this mess...

N01#28.zh: 你在烦恼什么啊？！不用在意！我找官府麻烦又不是第一次了！况且你要是被那些官军捉走，那么你娘怎么办？
N01#28.t: What are you fretting about? Don't give it a thought! This isn't the first time I've crossed the authorities. Besides, if those soldiers had taken you, what would become of your mother?

N01#29.zh: 娘应该到达安全的地方了，我得赶紧赶上去。多谢壮士相救。啊...
N01#29.t: Mother should be somewhere safe by now. I must hurry after her. Thank you for saving us, friend. Ah...

N01#30.zh: 受伤的人还那么勉强。来，扶住我的肩膀，我护送你们一程。
N01#30.t: Still pushing yourself when you're hurt. Here, lean on my shoulder. I'll see you both on your way.

N01#31.zh: 在%N的帮助下，王母暂时逃脱了官兵的追捕。
N01#31.t: With %N's help, Wang's mother escaped the soldiers for now.
